headline: EU Regulatory Update: Omnibus Directive Adopted and Taxonomy Simplified
summary: The EU has formally adopted the Omnibus Directive, confirming your CSRD reporting timeline for FY2027 while keeping your business outside direct CSDDD obligations. The Commission also simplified EU Taxonomy screening criteria to ease reporting burdens. Meanwhile, clarity on upcoming 2027 battery QR code rules remains outstanding.

items.title: EU Omnibus Directive adopted, setting CSRD scope and CSDDD exemptions
items.what: The EU has formally adopted the Omnibus Directive, amending reporting requirements and application timelines for both CSRD and CSDDD.
items.meaning: Your company remains within CSRD scope starting FY2027 due to your size, but is confirmed outside the direct scope of CSDDD.
items.action: Finalise FY2027 CSRD implementation plans under the revised parameters.

sources.title: European Union adopts Omnibus Directive amending CSRD and CS3D

items.title: Commission simplifies technical screening criteria for EU Taxonomy
items.what: The European Commission adopted revised EU Taxonomy criteria to remove duplicative requirements and streamline rules for classifying sustainable economic activities.
items.meaning: Eases the technical reporting burden for your mandatory CSRD Taxonomy disclosures regarding eligible power tool and equipment lines.
items.action: Review the simplified screening criteria when mapping product taxonomy eligibility.

sources.title: EU Commission Simplifies EU Taxonomy Criteria
European Commission Cuts Duplicative Requirements From EU Taxonomy Criteria, Clarifies Compliance Rules
Commission adopts amended criteria to simplify the EU Taxonomy

items.title: Battery QR code deadline approaches while detailed rules remain pending
items.what: Reports note that while the 2027 deadline for mandatory battery QR codes is fixed, the European Commission has not yet published detailed technical specifications.
items.meaning: Creates uncertainty for technical implementation on your proprietary battery platform, though data gathering requirements remain on the horizon.
items.action: Maintain battery supply chain data collection with Chinese suppliers while awaiting detailed specifications.

sources.title: Brussels Sets a 2027 Deadline for Battery QR Codes — but Its Own Rulebook Is Still Missing

items.title: EUDR customs codes updated ahead of December enforcement
items.what: The Commission adjusted customs codes for EUDR compliance covering exports and re-imports shortly before the 30 December implementation date.
items.meaning: Applies to imported products containing timber components or wood-based packaging from your Chinese manufacturing partners.
items.action: Confirm customs reporting readiness for any timber elements or paper packaging.
